title: InEgypt features: trip planner, metro and train routes, fair prices
description: Everything InEgypt does, what is free and what is part of InEgypt Pro, and the honest limit of each feature.
lead: Each feature below says what it does, its limit, and whether it is free or part of InEgypt Pro. Most of InEgypt is free.

items.name: Automatic trip plan
items.benefit: Dates and what you like in, a day-by-day plan out.
items.detail: Choose when you travel, how long and what you like. InEgypt builds each day in a sensible order with real travel time between stops, and tells you why it chose that order. Trips across cities are joined by real transport, such as the train to Luxor.
items.limit: Works best for the main visitor cities; smaller cities have fewer places. The first automatic plans are free; more are part of InEgypt Pro.

items.name: Bring your plan
items.benefit: Paste a plan you already have, even one from ChatGPT.
items.detail: InEgypt reads the text, finds the places and sorts them into Found, To check and Your own. Then it orders the days and shows the travel time. Anything it does not know is kept as you wrote it.
items.limit: It reads places and days, not bookings or flight numbers.

items.name: Trip day view
items.detail: Each day shows its visits, meal breaks, the walk or ride between stops and the time you should be done. You can add, move or remove stops, and the day is checked again.
items.limit: Opening hours come from the app's data and can change; check on the day.

items.name: Get ready and arrival
items.benefit: What to prepare before you fly, and what to do when you land.
items.detail: A short checklist before the trip and arrival notes for the airport: getting out, the options to the city and the fair price for each.
items.limit: The arrival notes are for Cairo International.

items.name: Routes on public transport
items.benefit: Every way to get there, in one search.
items.detail: Cairo Metro, monorail, LRT, BRT, Alexandria tram, national trains and intercity coaches. Each result shows time, fare and changes, and you can compare options. Route search is free and has no daily limit.
items.limit: Times are published timetables. Local buses in Cairo and Alexandria are a fallback and less complete. Offline route search is part of InEgypt Pro.

items.name: Step-by-step route details
items.benefit: Which line, which direction, where to change.
items.detail: Each route opens into steps: the walk to the station, the line and direction, the number of stops, the change, and the fare for the journey.
items.limit: Fares are estimates from published fare rules; the operator's price is final.

items.name: Train timetables
items.benefit: National trains in the same search.
items.detail: Cairo–Alexandria and the line to Luxor and Aswan, with train numbers and departure times from the published timetable. InEgypt links to the official seller for tickets.
items.limit: No ticket sales in the app. Check the time before you travel.

items.name: Search
items.benefit: One box for places, stations and lines.
items.detail: Type a museum, a station, a line or a city; results are grouped by kind. The same search is used when you pick a start and an end for a route, and by Siri.

items.name: Map
items.benefit: The transit lines, on the map.
items.detail: Metro, monorail, LRT, BRT, tram and train lines with their stops, your route drawn on top, and the places from your trip.
items.limit: No vehicle positions on the map.

items.name: What things cost
items.benefit: The fair price, with the date it was checked.
items.detail: Price ranges for taxis, tips, food, drinks and tickets, each with its source and the date it was last checked.
items.limit: A range, not a quote. Prices in Egypt change; the date tells you how fresh it is.

items.name: Situations & tips
items.benefit: The common scams, and what to do.
items.detail: Short, plain notes on what happens at the airport, in taxis, at the sights, in shops and at stations, and what to do. They also appear in context, on the place or route where they matter.

items.name: Emergency
items.benefit: The numbers you need, with no signal.
items.detail: Police, ambulance, tourist police and the tourism hotline on one page that opens offline.

items.name: Discover
items.benefit: Cities, places and things to do, chosen for Egypt.
items.detail: {attractions} places to visit in {cities} cities, with trip ideas and activities. Any place can be added to your trip from its page.
items.limit: Not a booking service: no hotels, flights or tours are sold.

items.name: Place pages
items.benefit: What to know before you go.
items.detail: Each place has a description, practical notes, and the fair prices and common tricks for that kind of place. Where an official ticket seller exists, there is a link.
items.limit: Ticket prices are shown only where an official source was checked.

items.name: Siri and Shortcuts
items.detail: Ask Siri for directions, your next stop, your trip plan or a fair price, or build them into Shortcuts.
items.limit: Works in the languages Siri supports on your device.

items.name: Offline
items.detail: A saved trip, place pages and the emergency page open offline for free. InEgypt Pro adds offline route search and offline Discover.
items.limit: Offline routes are part of InEgypt Pro.

items.name: 9 languages, Arabic first-class
items.benefit: The whole app in your language.
items.detail: English, Arabic, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Turkish and Chinese (Simplified). Arabic is fully right to left.
items.limit: This website is in English and Arabic only.

items.name: Trip weather and expenses
items.benefit: The extras for the trip itself.
items.detail: Weather for every day of your trip and a simple expense tracker. The currency converter and trip notes are free.
items.limit: Trip weather and expenses are part of InEgypt Pro.

items.name: No account
items.detail: There is nothing to sign up for. Trips are stored on your device.
